text:
mona: Deployed v2.21.0 -> eu-west-4 (canary). Kicking off smoke checks: tokenization, structured-output validation, and kv-warmup. Will watch for 20m.

deploy-bot: canary applied at 3% traffic to eu-west-4. readiness/liveness OK. triggering synth-smoke (short).

tarik: Short-suite started: `./smoke/run --quick --region=eu-west-4 --checks=tok,struct,kv` — posting interim.

sre-bot: short-suite results (so far): 45/45 quick checks OK, p50=42ms p95=110ms. KV warmup hit-rate lower than baseline (~82% vs 96%).

ellie: Pasting two structured-output failures from synth (minor schema mismatch):
```
expected: {"choices":[{"content":{"type":"buttons","items":[...]}}]}
actual:   {"choices":[{"content":{"type":"button_list","items":[...]}}]}
```
mona: Interesting — looks like a rename of payload type `buttons` -> `button_list` slipped into the model adapter. Risk: library consumers that assert on schema could error. Propose: pause global ramp, pin routes that use structured payloads to v2.20.9, keep canary at 3% for 30m while we triage. If structured failure rate >0.4% for 5m or any production error from schema assertion -> rollback to v2.20.9.

deploy-bot: rollout: paused by mona. pin set: eu-west-4 structured-routes -> v2.20.9 at 3% until 3210009577.

tarik: I'm running extended suite now (`--suite=extended --repeat=2`) and will post diffs. Also pulling adapter change diff: https://git.redwood/changes/adapter/53df — looks like a small serialization rename.

sre-bot: KV warmup mitigation suggestion: increase kv-prefill parallelism on canary hosts to improve hit-rate temporarily: `kubectl set env deployment/kv-prefill PREFILL_PAR=8 -n eu-west-4-canary` — would you like me to apply?

mona: Go ahead and apply the prefill bump only on canary hosts. tarik, team should revert the serialization rename in adapter and run a patch release if tests confirm. Add release note entry: "Adapter serialization key renamed; pinned structured routes while we roll out patch."

release-bot: Note added to release: "v2.21.0: structured-output key rename observed in canary; monitoring in eu-west-4. Pinning structured routes and delaying staged ramp until verification."

tarik: Extended-suite interim: 100/100 queries OK for semantics, 2/100 flagged for struct-schema mismatch (same rename). No semantic regressions. Running a targeted unit + integration patch verification now.

sre-bot: Prefill env updated on canary prefiller: PREFILL_PAR=8. Observed kv hit-rate climb to ~93% after pod warmup.

mona: Decision for this checkpoint: keep canary at 3% and structured-route pin for 30m. Owners: tarik (fix & patch), sre-bot (kv warmup mitigation & alerts), ellie (monitor schema assertion logs). Re-evaluate in 20m. If struct failures drop to <=0.05% and kv hit-rate >=92% -> proceed to 25% tomorrow change window. If structured failures >0.4% for any 5m window -> rollback.

tarik: Working on patch. Will open PR and request fast CI. Posting PR link when ready.

ellie: I set an alert: `alert:structured.assertions.rate > 0.05% for 5m` -> notify #oncall. Dash link: https://console.redwood/dashboards/struct-schema-eu-west-4

mona: Thanks. Reconvene in 20m or earlier on any threshold breach.
